title: Viral Whitelist
description: Everybody whitelisted can whitelist their friends!
body:
# Everyone on the Server can Whitelist their friends!
With this **mod** everybody on the server can use the `/whitelist add <player>` command.  
Ideal for your next **SMP** with your **friends** and **friends of friends**.  
Be a **happy** and **stress free** server owner that does not constantly get asked to whitelist someone at **3 am** and enjoy your sleep!  
Don't forget to actually turn on your whitelist with `/whitelist on`!

## Command
![Whitelist command being typed out](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4522bbee2dcc9aa52c3b79ad52620dd49fdbb9f6.png)

![Chat message that reports the success of the whitelist command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9f17379cba381011dac13b08dadda05ad81a3b2.png)

## Pros and Cons
|❌ No Whitelist|❌ Whitelist|❌ OP Everyone|✔️ Viral Whitelist|
|:----------:|:-------:|:---------:|:-------------:|
|Griefers can find and join your server :(|You have to manually whitelist everybody|Everybody can go in creative/cheat|All of your friends can add their friends at any time :)|
